requirements.quote: The sound level measured in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 3.1. of Annex 3 to this Regulation
requirements.text: The vehicle shall not exceed a sound level of 68 dB(A) when measured in accordance with Annex 3 paragraph 3.1 and rounded to the nearest integer, where it is an M1 vehicle with PMR < 120 in phase 3.
The vehicle shall not exceed a sound level of 68 dB(A) for the phase 3 limit where the M1 vehicle has PMR < 120.
The vehicle shall not exceed a sound level of 69 dB(A) in phase 3 where the M1 vehicle has PMR between 120 and 160.

requirements.quote: The sound level measured in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 3.1. of Annex 3 to this Regulation, mathematically rounded to the nearest integer value
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be judged against the sound level limits with the measured value mathematically rounded to the nearest integer value.

requirements.quote: The sound made by the vehicle type submitted for approval shall be measured either indoors or outdoors by the methods described in Annex 3
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be able to be measured either indoors or outdoors by the methods described in Annex 3, with the results of the outdoor and indoor tests deemed equivalent.

requirements.quote: In addition, the sound shall be measured on the stationary3 vehicle; in the case of a vehicle where an internal combustion engine cannot operate when the vehicle is stationary, the emitted sound shall only be measured in motion.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall have its emitted sound measured only in motion where it is a vehicle whose internal combustion engine cannot operate when the vehicle is stationary; when an internal combustion engine cannot operate when the vehicle is stationary, the emitted sound shall only be measured in motion.

requirements.quote: In the case of a hybrid electrical vehicle of category M1 where an internal combustion engine cannot operate when the vehicle is stationary, the emitted sound shall be measured according to Annex 3, paragraph 4.
requirements.text: For a category M1 hybrid electric vehicle in which the internal combustion engine cannot operate when the vehicle is stationary, the emitted sound shall be measured according to Annex 3, paragraph 4.

requirements.quote: Any electric sound enhancement system for the purpose of the exterior sound emission shall be operational during the type-approval test.
requirements.text: The acoustic vehicle alerting system shall be operational during the type-approval test.

requirements.quote: The sound emission of the vehicle under typical on-road driving conditions, which are different from those under which the type-approval test set out in Annex 3 and Annex 7 was carried out, shall not deviate from the test result in a significant manner.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall not deviate significantly from the type-approval test result in exterior sound emission under typical on-road driving conditions different from those of the Annex 3 and Annex 7 tests.

requirements.quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall not intentionally alter, adjust, or introduce any mechanical, electrical, thermal, or other device or procedure solely for the purpose of fulfilling the sound emission requirements
requirements.text: The AVAS shall not include any mechanical, electrical, thermal or other device or procedure introduced solely to fulfil the sound emission requirements which is not operational during typical on-road operation.

requirements.quote: The vehicle shall meet the requirements of Annex 7 to this Regulation.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall meet the additional sound emission provisions of Annex 7.

requirements.quote: The vehicle, its engine and its sound reduction system shall be so designed, constructed and assembled as to enable the vehicle, in normal use, despite the vibration to which it may be subjected, to comply with the provisions of this Regulation.
requirements.text: The AVAS and its mounting shall be designed, constructed and assembled so that the vehicle complies with this Regulation in normal use despite the vibration to which it is subjected.

requirements.quote: The sound reduction system shall be so designed, constructed and assembled as to be able to reasonably resist the corrosive phenomena to which it is exposed having regard to the conditions of use of the vehicle, including regional climate differences, and against manipulation.
requirements.text: The sound reduction system components shall be able to reasonably resist the corrosive phenomena to which they are exposed, including regional climate differences, and resist manipulation.

requirements.quote: The components of the sound reduction system, excluding fixing hardware and piping, shall bear:
requirements.text: The components of the sound reduction system, excluding fixing hardware and piping, shall bear the manufacturer's identification markings.

requirements.quote: The trade name or mark of the manufacturer of the sound reduction system and of its components; and
requirements.text: The AVAS components shall bear the trade name or mark of the manufacturer of the sound reduction system and of its components.

requirements.quote: The manufacturer's trade description;
requirements.text: The AVAS components shall bear the manufacturer's trade description.

requirements.quote: These markings shall be clearly legible and be indelible even after fitting.
requirements.text: The markings on the sound reduction system components shall be clearly legible and indelible even after fitting.

requirements.quote: The approval mark shall be clearly legible and be indelible.
requirements.text: The vehicle's approval mark shall be clearly legible and indelible.

requirements.quote: The approval mark shall be placed close to or on the vehicle data plate affixed by the manufacturer.
requirements.text: The approval mark shall be placed close to or on the vehicle data plate affixed by the manufacturer.

requirements.quote: There shall be affixed, conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form, to every vehicle conforming to a vehicle type approved under this Regulation an international approval mark
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be affixed with an international approval mark conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form.

requirements.quote: The apparatus used for measuring the sound level shall be a precision sound-level meter or equivalent measurement system meeting the requirements of Class 1 instruments
requirements.text: For verification of the AVAS sound level, the apparatus used for measuring the sound level shall be a precision sound-level meter or equivalent system meeting Class 1 requirements of IEC 61672-1:2002.

requirements.quote: Measurements shall be carried out using the "fast" response of the acoustic measurement instrument and the "A" weighting curve also described in "IEC 61672-1:2002".
requirements.text: Sound level measurements of the vehicle shall be carried out using the fast response and the A weighting curve of IEC 61672-1:2002.

requirements.quote: At the beginning and at the end of every measurement session the entire measurement system shall be checked by means of a sound calibrator that fulfils the requirements for sound calibrators of at least precision Class 1 according to IEC 60942:2003.
requirements.text: At the beginning and end of every measurement session the entire acoustic measurement system shall be checked with a sound calibrator meeting at least Class 1 of IEC 60942:2003.

requirements.quote: Without any further adjustment the difference between the readings of two consecutive checks shall be less than or equal to 0.5 dB.
requirements.text: The difference between the readings of two consecutive calibration checks shall be less than or equal to 0.5 dB without any further adjustment.

requirements.quote: The road speed of the vehicle shall be measured with a continuous speed measuring device having an accuracy of at least ±0.5 km/h.
requirements.text: The road speed input to the AVAS shall be capable of being measured with a continuous speed measuring device having an accuracy of at least ±0.5 km/h.

requirements.quote: The measurements shall be made when the ambient air temperature is within the range from 5 °C to 40 °C and the test surface temperature within the range from 5 °C to 60 °C.
requirements.text: The AVAS shall be testable and remain functional when the ambient air temperature is within 5 °C to 40 °C and the test surface temperature within 5 °C to 60 °C.

requirements.quote: The tests shall not be carried out if the wind speed, including gusts, at microphone height exceeds 5 m/s, during the sound measurement interval.
requirements.text: The AVAS sound measurement shall not be carried out if the wind speed including gusts at microphone height exceeds 5 m/s during the measurement interval.

requirements.quote: The background noise (including any wind noise) shall be at least 10 dB(A) below the A-weighted sound pressure level produced by the vehicle under test.
requirements.text: The AVAS-generated sound level shall be at least 10 dB(A) above the background noise including wind noise during the measurement.

requirements.quote: The test mass mt of the vehicle shall be between 0.9 mro ≤ mt ≤ 1.2 mro
requirements.text: For an M1 vehicle, the test mass mt shall be between 0.9 mro and 1.2 mro during the sound measurement.

requirements.quote: If so equipped, propulsion batteries shall have a state-of-charge sufficiently high to enable all key functionalities according to the specifications of the vehicle manufacturer.
requirements.text: The propulsion battery shall have a state of charge sufficiently high to enable all key functionalities according to the manufacturer's specifications during the test.

requirements.quote: Any active sound devices, either for noise control, or sound enhancement, shall operate as foreseen by the vehicle manufacturer and not be interfered with during the measurements.
requirements.text: The AVAS shall operate as foreseen by the vehicle manufacturer and shall not be interfered with during the sound measurements.

requirements.quote: At least four measurements shall be made on each side of the vehicle and for each gear. Preliminary measurements may be made for adjustment purposes, but shall be disregarded.
requirements.text: At least four valid measurements shall be made on each side of the vehicle for each test condition, with preliminary adjustment measurements disregarded.

requirements.quote: For outdoor testing the microphones shall be located on both sides of the pathway at a distance of 7.5 m ± 0.05 m from the reference line CC' of the track and 1.2 m ± 0.02 m above the ground.
requirements.text: For outdoor testing the AVAS sound shall be measured with microphones located on both sides of the pathway at 7.5 m ± 0.05 m from line CC' and 1.2 m ± 0.02 m above the ground.

requirements.quote: The test speed vtest is 50 km/h ± 1 km/h. The test speed shall be reached, when the reference point is at line PP'.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be driven at a test speed of 50 km/h ± 1 km/h during the pass-by measurement, the test speed being reached when the reference point is at line PP'.

requirements.quote: The gear selector position for forward driving shall be used.
requirements.text: For a battery electric vehicle with only one gear ratio, the gear selector position for forward driving shall be used for the test.

requirements.quote: The achieved acceleration awot test shall be greater or equal to aurban.
requirements.text: The achieved acceleration awot test of the battery electric vehicle during the acceleration test shall be greater than or equal to aurban.

requirements.quote: If possible, the manufacturer shall take measures to avoid an acceleration value awot test greater than 2.0 m/s2.
requirements.text: Where possible, the vehicle shall be provided with measures to avoid an acceleration value awot test greater than 2.0 m/s².

requirements.quote: The accelerator shall be kept in this depressed condition until the rear of the vehicle reaches line BB'.
requirements.text: During the acceleration test the accelerator shall be kept fully depressed until the rear of the vehicle reaches line BB'.

requirements.quote: The constant speed test shall be carried out with the same gear(s) specified for the acceleration test and a constant speed of 50 km/h with a tolerance of ±1 km/h between AA' and BB'
requirements.text: The constant speed test shall be carried out at a constant speed of 50 km/h with a tolerance of ±1 km/h between lines AA' and BB'.

requirements.quote: The first four valid consecutive measurement results, within 2 dB(A), allowing for the deletion of non-valid results (see paragraph 2.1.), shall be used for the further calculations below.
requirements.text: The first four valid consecutive measurement results within 2 dB(A) shall be used for the calculation of the sound result.

requirements.quote: The final value Lurban mathematically rounded to the nearest integer shall be the higher value of the two sides.
requirements.text: The final Lurban value shall be the higher of the two sides' values, mathematically rounded to the nearest integer.

requirements.quote: The measurement results shall be entered into the Addendum to the Communication form (Annex 1, Appendix 1).
requirements.text: The stationary sound level measurement results shall be documented to enable comparison with the type-approval value.

requirements.quote: At least three measurements shall be taken at each measuring point.
requirements.text: At least three measurements shall be taken at each measuring point for the stationary sound measurement.

requirements.quote: The sound level shall not exceed the limit of 72 dB(A).
requirements.text: Where the vehicle is fitted with a compressed air brake system and has a maximum mass above 2,800 kg, the compressed air noise shall not exceed 72 dB(A).

requirements.quote: Vehicle acceleration aWOT_ASEP: aWOT ≤ 5.0 m/s2
requirements.text: The AVAS and vehicle shall be evaluated within the ASEP control range where the vehicle acceleration aWOT does not exceed 5.0 m/s².

requirements.quote: If the ratio awot_test,PP-BB / awot_test,AA-BB does not exceed or is equal to 1,20, then proceed with the acceleration calculation between line AA' and Line BB'.
requirements.text: During the ASEP assessment, acceleration shall be calculated between AA' and BB' where the ratio awot_test,PP-BB / awot_test,AA-BB does not exceed 1.20.

requirements.quote: The slopeκ of a particular gear for the further calculation is the derived result of the calculation in paragraph 3.2.1. rounded to the first decimal place, but not higher than 5 dB(A)/1,000 min-1.
requirements.text: The slope of the regression line for each gear ratio used in the ASEP calculation shall not be higher than 5 dB(A)/1,000 min⁻¹.

requirements.quote: The sound level of every specified measurement point shall not exceed the limits given below:
requirements.text: The sound level of the vehicle at every specified ASEP measurement point shall not exceed the ASEP limit Lκj ≤ LASEP_κ.j + x.

requirements.quote: Δ Lurban_ASEP shall be less than or equal to 3.0 dB(A) + limit value3 - Lurban .
requirements.text: When the Lurban assessment method is used, the deviation ΔLurban_ASEP shall be less than or equal to 3.0 dB(A) + limit value - Lurban.

requirements.quote: For vehicles of category M1, Lref shall be less than or equal to 76 dB(A).
requirements.text: For a category M1 vehicle, the reference sound level Lref shall be less than or equal to 76 dB(A).

requirements.quote: In any case it shall be ensured that the remaining tyre/road sound shall be at least 10 dB below the maximum A-weighted sound pressure level produced by the vehicle under test.
requirements.text: When the vehicle is tested indoors, the remaining tyre/road sound shall be at least 10 dB below the maximum A-weighted sound pressure level produced by the vehicle.

requirements.quote: vehicles which have no ICE for propulsion are exempted from RD-ASEP, if a sound enhancement system is fitted to the vehicle solely for the purpose of fulfilling the provisions of UN Regulation No. 138
requirements.text: A battery electric vehicle equipped with the AVAS solely to fulfil UN Regulation No. 138 shall be exempted from RD-ASEP, provided the AVAS does not emit more than 75 dB(A) at 2 m under any operating condition exceeding the UN Regulation No. 138 specification range.

requirements.quote: the sound emitting device (AVAS) does not emit a sound pressure level of more than 75 dB(A) 8 under any operation conditions exceeding the specification range of UN Regulation No.138.
requirements.text: The AVAS shall not emit a sound pressure level exceeding 75 dB(A) measured at 2 m under any operation condition exceeding the specification range of UN Regulation No. 138.

requirements.quote: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.text: The AVAS and its electrical/electronic systems shall be designed, constructed and fitted so that the vehicle complies with UN R10 in normal conditions of use.

requirements.quote: ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
requirements.text: The AVAS controller as an ESA shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions and for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.

requirements.quote: A vehicle shall be tested for radiated emissions and for immunity to radiated disturbances. No tests for conducted emissions or immunity to conducted disturbances are required for vehicle type approval.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be tested for radiated emissions and immunity to radiated disturbances, without conducted emission or immunity tests for the vehicle type approval.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 32 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band and 32 to 43 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: At a 10.0 ± 0.2 m antenna spacing, the vehicle broadband radiated emission shall not exceed 32 dBµV/m from 30 to 75 MHz and 32 to 43 dBµV/m from 75 to 400 MHz.

requirements.quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 43 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.text: The vehicle broadband radiated emission shall not exceed 43 dBµV/m in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: At a 3.0 ± 0.05 m antenna spacing, the vehicle broadband radiated emission shall not exceed 42 dBµV/m from 30 to 75 MHz and 42 to 53 dBµV/m from 75 to 400 MHz.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 28 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 230 MHz frequency band and 35 dB microvolts/m in the 230 to 1,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.text: At a 10.0 ± 0.2 m antenna spacing, the vehicle narrowband radiated emission shall not exceed 28 dBµV/m from 30 to 230 MHz and 35 dBµV/m from 230 to 1,000 MHz.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 38 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 230 MHz frequency band and 45 dB microvolts/m in the 230 to 1,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.text: At a 3.0 ± 0.05 m antenna spacing, the vehicle narrowband radiated emission shall not exceed 38 dBµV/m from 30 to 230 MHz and 45 dBµV/m from 230 to 1,000 MHz.

requirements.quote: On the vehicle representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limit.
requirements.text: The measured vehicle narrowband emission values, expressed in dBµV/m, shall be below the type approval limits.

requirements.quote: the field strength shall be 30 volts/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 25 volts/m over the whole 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall withstand a radiated field strength of 30 V/m over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz band and a minimum of 25 V/m over the whole band without degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.quote: The field strength shall be 10 volts/m in over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 8 volts/m over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall withstand a radiated field strength of 10 V/m over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz band and a minimum of 8 V/m over the whole band without degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.quote: the current shall be 60 mA in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 50 mA over the whole 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.text: When tested by the BCI method, the vehicle shall withstand a current of 60 mA over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz band and a minimum of 50 mA over the whole band.

requirements.quote: no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions", according to paragraph 2.1. of Annex 6.
requirements.text: The AVAS shall show no degradation of performance of its immunity related functions, including the sound generation and the fault warning, during the vehicle immunity tests.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz
requirements.text: The ESA broadband radiated emission shall not exceed 62 to 52 dBµV/m in the 30 to 75 MHz band, decreasing logarithmically with frequency above 30 MHz.

requirements.quote: 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
requirements.text: The ESA broadband radiated emission shall not exceed 52 to 63 dBµV/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, increasing logarithmically above 75 MHz.

requirements.quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.text: The ESA broadband radiated emission shall not exceed 63 dBµV/m in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz
requirements.text: The ESA narrowband radiated emission shall not exceed 52 to 42 dBµV/m in the 30 to 75 MHz band, decreasing logarithmically with frequency above 30 MHz.

requirements.quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.text: The ESA narrowband radiated emission shall not exceed 53 dBµV/m in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band.

requirements.quote: Positive +75 V
requirements.text: The AVAS controller on a 12 V system shall not emit transient conducted disturbances on the supply lines with a positive pulse amplitude exceeding +75 V.

requirements.quote: Negative -100 V
requirements.text: The AVAS controller on a 12 V system shall not emit transient conducted disturbances on the supply lines with a negative pulse amplitude exceeding -100 V.

requirements.quote: 60 mA
requirements.text: The AVAS controller shall withstand a BCI immunity test level of 60 mA over 90 per cent of the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range.

requirements.quote: 30 V/m
requirements.text: The AVAS controller shall withstand an ALSE immunity test level of 30 V/m from 80 to 2,000 MHz over 90 per cent of the band.

requirements.quote: 60 V/m
requirements.text: The AVAS controller shall withstand a stripline immunity test level of 60 V/m from 20 to 400 MHz.

requirements.quote: 10 V/m
requirements.text: The AVAS controller shall withstand an ALSE immunity test level of 10 V/m from 2,000 to 6,000 MHz.

requirements.quote: there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".
requirements.text: The AVAS controller shall show no degradation of performance of its immunity related functions during the ESA immunity tests.

requirements.quote: 1 -75 V -450 V 500 pulses III III
requirements.text: The AVAS controller on a 12 V system shall withstand test pulse 1 at -75 V for 500 pulses with functional status III.

requirements.quote: 2a +37 V +37 V 500 pulses I III
requirements.text: The AVAS controller on a 12 V system shall withstand test pulse 2a at +37 V for 500 pulses with functional status I for immunity related functions.

requirements.quote: 2b +10 V +20 V 10 pulses II III
requirements.text: The AVAS controller on a 12 V system shall withstand test pulse 2b at +10 V for 10 pulses with functional status II for immunity related functions.

requirements.quote: 3a -112 V -150 V 1 h I III
requirements.text: The AVAS controller on a 12 V system shall withstand test pulse 3a at -112 V for 1 hour with functional status I for immunity related functions.

requirements.quote: 3b +75 V +150 V 1 h I III
requirements.text: The AVAS controller on a 12 V system shall withstand test pulse 3b at +75 V for 1 hour with functional status I for immunity related functions.

requirements.quote: Where a vehicle or electrical/electronic system or ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.3.2. or 6.6.2.
requirements.text: Where the AVAS controller does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with the narrowband emission limits.

requirements.quote: RF transmitters shall be tested in the transmit mode. Wanted emissions (e.g. from RF transmitting systems) within the necessary bandwidth and out of band emissions are disregarded
requirements.text: Where the AVAS includes an RF transmitter it shall be tested in transmit mode, with wanted emissions within the necessary bandwidth disregarded and spurious emissions subject to the Regulation.

requirements.quote: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. below shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation.
requirements.text: The AVAS controller, approved as an ESA, shall be affixed with the approval mark described in paragraph 5.3.

requirements.quote: A circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
requirements.text: The approval mark on the AVAS controller shall comprise a circle containing the letter E followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.

requirements.quote: The number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1. above.
requirements.text: The approval mark shall show the number of this Regulation, the letter R, a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle.

requirements.quote: Markings on ESAs in conformity with paragraph 5.3. above need not be visible when the ESA is installed in the vehicle.
requirements.text: The approval markings on the AVAS controller need not be visible when the controller is installed in the vehicle.

requirements.quote: a = 6 mm min
requirements.text: The characters of the AVAS controller's approval mark shall have a minimum height of 6 mm.

requirements.quote: Vehicle is tested in an operating state where the AVAS Function/sound is active (if applicable) (1)
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be tested in an operating state in which the AVAS function and sound are active during the vehicle immunity test.

requirements.quote: Loss of AVAS function (loss of sound or system error indicator)
requirements.text: The AVAS shall not exhibit a loss of function, loss of sound or spurious system error indicator during the vehicle immunity test.

requirements.quote: The vehicle shall be in an unladen condition except for necessary test equipment.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be in an unladen condition except for necessary test equipment during the immunity test.

requirements.quote: The engine shall normally turn the driving wheels at a steady speed of 50 km/h if there is no technical reason due to the vehicle to define a different condition.
requirements.text: The driving wheels shall be turned at a steady speed of 50 km/h during the vehicle immunity test where no technical reason requires a different condition.

requirements.quote: The vehicle shall be exposed to electromagnetic radiation in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges in vertical polarization.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be exposed to electromagnetic radiation in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range in vertical polarization during the immunity test.

requirements.quote: AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range
requirements.text: The immunity test signal shall be amplitude modulated with 1 kHz and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range.

requirements.quote: PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges.
requirements.text: The immunity test signal shall use PM3 modulation with Ton 500 µs and period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and 3,100 to 6,000 MHz ranges.

requirements.quote: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.text: The ESA emission limits shall apply throughout the 30 to 1,000 MHz frequency range for measurements in an ALSE or OATS.

requirements.quote: If peak detectors are used a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied.
requirements.text: Where peak detectors are used for the ESA emission measurement, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied.

requirements.quote: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.text: The AVAS controller shall be in normal operation mode, preferably at maximum load, during the emission measurement.

requirements.quote: the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation
requirements.text: The extraneous noise or signal during the AVAS controller narrowband measurement shall be at least 6 dB below the interference limits of paragraph 6.6.2.1.

requirements.quote: Measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.text: The AVAS controller immunity measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.

requirements.quote: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
requirements.text: The AVAS controller shall be switched on and stimulated to be in normal operation condition during the immunity test.

requirements.quote: BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA
requirements.text: Where the BCI immunity test is performed on the AVAS controller, the injection probe shall be positioned at 150 mm distance from the ESA when the substitution method is used.

requirements.quote: Apply the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs
requirements.text: The AVAS controller shall be subjected to test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to ISO 7637-2 on the supply lines and on other connections operationally connected to supply lines.

requirements.quote: ESAs that are exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to starting profile.
requirements.text: The AVAS controller, being reserved for a battery electric vehicle without a 12 V/24 V starter motor, shall not be subject to the starting profile test.

requirements.quote: For an ESA powered by LV, a 5 µH / 50 Ω AN as defined in Figure 1 shall be used.
requirements.text: The AVAS controller, powered by low voltage, shall be tested using a 5 µH / 50 Ω artificial network as defined in Figure 1 of Appendix 8.

requirements.quote: The AN(s) shall be mounted directly on the ground plane. The grounding connection of the AN(s) shall be bonded to the ground plane.
requirements.text: The artificial network used for testing the AVAS controller shall be mounted directly on the ground plane with its grounding connection bonded to the ground plane.

requirements.quote: For high voltage live parts inside the passenger compartment, or luggage compartment, or trailer load compartment, the protection degree IPXXD shall be provided.
requirements.text: Where high voltage live parts of the AVAS are located inside the passenger or luggage compartment, the protection degree IPXXD shall be provided.

requirements.quote: For high voltage live parts in areas other than the passenger compartment, or luggage compartment or trailer load compartment, the protection degree IPXXB shall be provided.
requirements.text: Where high voltage live parts of the AVAS are located outside the passenger and luggage compartments, the protection degree IPXXB shall be provided.

requirements.quote: The symbol shown in Figure 2 shall be present on or near the REESS having high voltage capability. The symbol background shall be yellow, the bordering and the arrow shall be black.
requirements.text: The symbol shown in Figure 2 shall be present on or near high voltage AVAS components, with a yellow background and black bordering and arrow.

requirements.quote: The symbol shall also be visible on enclosures and electrical protection barriers, which, when removed, expose live parts of high voltage circuits.
requirements.text: The high voltage symbol shall be visible on AVAS enclosures and electrical protection barriers which, when removed, expose live parts of high voltage circuits.

requirements.quote: Cables for high voltage buses which are not located within enclosures shall be identified by having an outer covering with the colour orange.
requirements.text: High voltage cables of the AVAS which are not located within enclosures shall be identified by an orange outer covering.

requirements.quote: The resistance between all exposed conductive parts and the electrical chassis shall be lower than 0.1 ohm when there is current flow of at least 0.2 amperes.
requirements.text: The resistance between all exposed conductive parts of the AVAS and the electrical chassis shall be lower than 0.1 Ω at a current flow of at least 0.2 A.

requirements.quote: The resistance between any two simultaneously reachable exposed conductive parts of the electrical protection barriers that are less than 2.5 m from each other shall not exceed 0.2 Ω.
requirements.text: The resistance between any two simultaneously reachable exposed conductive parts of the AVAS that are less than 2.5 m apart shall not exceed 0.2 Ω.

requirements.quote: The vehicle shall provide a warning to the driver when the vehicle is in active driving possible mode in the event specified in paragraphs 6.13. to 6.15.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall provide a warning to the driver when in active driving possible mode in the event of an operational failure of the vehicle controls managing safe operation of the REESS.

requirements.quote: In case of optical warning, the tell-tale shall, when illuminated, be sufficiently bright to be visible to the driver under both daylight and night-time driving conditions
requirements.text: Where the AVAS-linked warning is optical, the tell-tale shall, when illuminated, be sufficiently bright to be visible to the driver under both daylight and night-time driving conditions.

requirements.quote: This tell-tale shall be activated as a check of lamp function either when the propulsion system is turned to the "On" position, or when the propulsion system is in a position between "On" and "Start"
requirements.text: The warning tell-tale shall be activated as a lamp function check when the propulsion system is turned to the On position or to a designated check position between On and Start.

requirements.quote: For pure electric vehicles (vehicles equipped with a powertrain containing exclusively electric machines as propulsion energy converters and exclusively rechargeable electric energy storage systems as propulsion energy storage systems), a warning to the driver in the event of low REESS state of charge shall be provided.
requirements.text: The pure electric vehicle shall provide a warning to the driver in the event of low REESS state of charge.

requirements.quote: At least a momentary indication shall be given to the driver each time when the vehicle is first placed in "active driving possible mode'' after manual activation of the propulsion system.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall give at least a momentary indication to the driver each time it is first placed in active driving possible mode after manual activation of the propulsion system.

requirements.quote: When leaving the vehicle, the driver shall be informed by a signal (e.g. optical or audible signal) if the vehicle is still in the active driving possible mode.
requirements.text: When leaving the vehicle, the driver shall be informed by a signal if the vehicle is still in the active driving possible mode.

requirements.quote: If the REESS can be externally charged, vehicle movement by its own propulsion system shall be impossible as long as the vehicle connector is physically connected to the vehicle inlet.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be prevented from moving by its own propulsion system as long as the vehicle connector is physically connected to the vehicle inlet.

requirements.quote: The state of the drive direction control unit shall be identified to the driver.
requirements.text: The state of the drive direction control unit, which determines whether the forward or reverse alerting sound is emitted, shall be identified to the driver.

requirements.quote: The vehicles shall maintain isolation resistance after exposure to water (e.g. washing, driving through standing water).
requirements.text: The vehicle and the AVAS high voltage components shall maintain isolation resistance after exposure to water such as washing and driving through standing water.

requirements.quote: If an isolation resistance monitoring system is provided, and the isolation resistance less than the requirements given in paragraph 5.1.3. is detected, a warning shall be indicated to the driver.
requirements.text: Where an isolation resistance monitoring system is provided and an isolation resistance below the requirements of paragraph 5.1.3. is detected, a warning shall be indicated to the driver.

requirements.quote: isolation resistance between the high voltage bus and the electrical chassis shall have a minimum value of 100 Ω/volt of the working voltage for DC buses, and a minimum value of 500 Ω/volt of the working voltage for AC buses.
requirements.text: Where the AVAS high voltage DC bus is galvanically isolated from the AC bus, the isolation resistance between the high voltage bus and the electrical chassis shall be at least 100 Ω/V of the working voltage.

requirements.quote: If AC high voltage buses and DC high voltage buses are galvanically connected, isolation resistance between the high voltage bus and the electrical chassis shall have a minimum value of 500 Ω/volt of the working voltage.
requirements.text: Where the AVAS AC and DC high voltage buses are galvanically connected, the isolation resistance between the high voltage bus and the electrical chassis shall be at least 500 Ω/V of the working voltage.

requirements.quote: The approval mark shall be clearly legible and shall be indelible.
requirements.text: The approval mark on the vehicle or REESS shall be clearly legible and indelible.

requirements.quote: In the case of a vehicle, the approval mark shall be placed on or close to the vehicle data plate affixed by the manufacturer.
requirements.text: In the case of the vehicle, the approval mark shall be placed on or close to the vehicle data plate affixed by the manufacturer.

requirements.quote: There shall be affixed, conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form, to every vehicle or REESS conforming to a type approved under this Regulation an international approval mark
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be affixed with an international approval mark conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form.

requirements.quote: a = 8 mm min.
requirements.text: The characters of the approval mark shall have a minimum height of 8 mm.

requirements.quote: The access probe shall not touch live parts.
requirements.text: The access probe shall not touch the live parts of the AVAS when tested for protection against direct contact.

requirements.quote: In the case of the test for protection degree IPXXB, the jointed test finger may penetrate to its 80 mm length, but the stop face (diameter 50 mm x 20 mm) shall not pass through the opening.
requirements.text: For IPXXB verification of the AVAS enclosures, the jointed test finger may penetrate to its 80 mm length but the stop face of 50 mm × 20 mm shall not pass through the opening.

requirements.quote: In case of the tests for protection degree IPXXD, the access probe may penetrate to its full length, but the stop face shall not fully penetrate through the opening.
requirements.text: For IPXXD verification of the AVAS enclosures, the access probe may penetrate to its full length but the stop face shall not fully penetrate through the opening.

requirements.quote: Resistance tester: Measurement current at least 0.2 A;
requirements.text: The resistance tester used to verify potential equalization of the AVAS shall provide a measurement current of at least 0.2 A.

requirements.quote: Resolution: 0.01 Ω or less;
requirements.text: The resistance tester used to verify potential equalization of the AVAS shall have a resolution of 0.01 Ω or less.

requirements.quote: The resistance R shall be less than 0.1 Ω.
requirements.text: The measured resistance between exposed conductive parts of the AVAS and the electrical chassis shall be less than 0.1 Ω.

requirements.quote: The adjustment of SOC shall be conducted at an ambient temperature of 20 ± 10 °C for vehicle-based tests and 22 ± 5 °C for component-based tests.
requirements.text: The SOC adjustment of the REESS shall be conducted at an ambient temperature of 20 ± 10 °C for vehicle-based tests and 22 ± 5 °C for component-based tests.

requirements.quote: The standard cycle shall be conducted at an ambient temperature of 20 ± 10 °C.
requirements.text: The standard cycle applied to the REESS shall be conducted at an ambient temperature of 20 ± 10 °C.

requirements.quote: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation
requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be fitted so that, under normal conditions of use and despite vibration, they retain the prescribed characteristics and enable the vehicle to comply with UN R48.

requirements.quote: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road
requirements.text: The reference axis of each light-signalling lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road, with a tolerance of ±3° in each direction.

requirements.quote: Be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane
requirements.text: Lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane.

requirements.quote: Be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp;
requirements.text: Lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, except with regard to their interior structure.

requirements.quote: Satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.text: Lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.

requirements.quote: Have substantially identical photometric characteristics.
requirements.text: Lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics.

requirements.quote: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.text: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.

requirements.quote: White light emitted by a lamp fitted on the front of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.text: White light emitted by a lamp fitted on the front of the vehicle shall not be visible from the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.quote: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, side-marker lamps if fitted, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched on and off simultaneously.

requirements.quote: The electrical connections shall be such that the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are also switched ON.
requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps and front fog lamps cannot be switched on unless the lamps of paragraph 5.11 are also switched on.

requirements.quote: Reversing lamp: White
requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall emit white light.

requirements.quote: Direction-indicator lamp: Amber
requirements.text: The direction-indicator lamp shall emit amber light.

requirements.quote: Stop lamp: Red
requirements.text: The stop lamp shall emit red light.

requirements.quote: Rear position lamp: Red
requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall emit red light.

requirements.quote: Daytime running lamp: White
requirements.text: The daytime running lamp shall emit white light.

requirements.quote: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.text: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.

requirements.quote: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
requirements.text: All lamps installed on the vehicle shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations specified in paragraph 6.

requirements.quote: Mandatory on motor vehicles. Prohibited on trailers.
requirements.text: A main-beam headlamp shall be fitted as mandatory on the motor vehicle.

requirements.quote: Two, type approved according to Class B of the 01 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 149.
requirements.text: Two main-beam headlamps shall be fitted, type approved according to Class B of the 01 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 149.

requirements.quote: the main-beam headlamps may be switched ON only when the dipped-beam headlamps are manually activated or the conditions for automatic switching ON of dipped-beam headlamps exist.
requirements.text: The main-beam headlamps may be switched on only when the dipped-beam headlamps are manually activated or the conditions for automatic switching on of dipped-beam headlamps exist, except for intermittent luminous warnings.

requirements.quote: Closed-circuit tell-tale mandatory.
requirements.text: A closed-circuit tell-tale shall be provided and shall be mandatory for the main-beam headlamps.

requirements.quote: The reference value corresponding to an aggregate maximum intensity of the main-beam headlamps which can be switched ON simultaneously shall not exceed 100.
requirements.text: The reference value corresponding to the aggregate maximum intensity of the main-beam headlamps that can be switched on simultaneously shall not exceed 100.

requirements.quote: This maximum intensity shall be obtained by adding together the individual reference marks which are indicated on the several headlamps.
requirements.text: The maximum intensity of the main-beam headlamps shall be obtained by adding together the individual reference marks indicated on the several headlamps.

requirements.quote: Mandatory on motor vehicles. Prohibited on trailers.
requirements.text: A dipped-beam headlamp shall be fitted as mandatory on the motor vehicle.

requirements.quote: Two, type approved according to Class C of the 01 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 149
requirements.text: Two dipped-beam headlamps shall be fitted, type approved according to Class C of the 01 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 149.

requirements.quote: In height: not less than 500 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
requirements.text: The dipped-beam headlamps shall be mounted at a height of not less than 500 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.

requirements.quote: α = 15° upwards and 10° downwards,
requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the dipped-beam headlamps shall be ensured within a vertical angle of 15° upwards and 10° downwards.

requirements.quote: ß = 45° outwards and 10° inwards.
requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the dipped-beam headlamps shall be ensured within a horizontal angle of 45° outwards and 10° inwards.

requirements.quote: set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver's seat
requirements.text: The initial downward inclination of the dipped-beam cut-off shall be set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver's seat.

requirements.quote: The dipped-beam headlamps shall be switched ON and OFF automatically relative to the ambient light conditions according to the requirements of Annex 13.
requirements.text: The dipped-beam headlamps shall be switched on and off automatically relative to the ambient light conditions according to Annex 13.

requirements.quote: it shall always be possible to switch the dipped beam headlamps ON manually.
requirements.text: It shall always be possible to switch the dipped-beam headlamps on manually.

requirements.quote: Mandatory on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4. Optional on trailers of category O1.
requirements.text: A reversing lamp shall be fitted as mandatory on the motor vehicle.

requirements.quote: One device mandatory and a second device optional on motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm.
requirements.text: One reversing lamp shall be mandatory and a second optional on an M1 vehicle with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm.

requirements.quote: In height: not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be mounted at a height of not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.

requirements.quote: They shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be connected such that it can be switched on only if the reverse gear is engaged and the propulsion system is in a position permitting its operation.

requirements.quote: Mandatory.
requirements.text: Direction-indicator lamps shall be fitted as mandatory.

requirements.quote: The devices shall be type-approved according to the 01 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 6, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.text: The direction-indicator lamps shall be type approved according to the 01 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 6, or the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.quote: The height of the direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a and 2b, measured in accordance with paragraph 5.8., shall not be less than 350 mm and not more than 1,500 mm.
requirements.text: The height of the direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a and 2b shall not be less than 350 mm and not more than 1,500 mm.

requirements.quote: All direction-indicator lamps on one side of a vehicle shall be switched ON and OFF automatically as defined by applicable UN Regulations and/or by means of one control and shall flash in phase.
requirements.text: All direction-indicator lamps on one side of the vehicle shall be switched on and off by one control and shall flash in phase.

requirements.quote: Operating tell-tale mandatory for direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a and 2b. It may be visual or auditory or both.
requirements.text: An operating tell-tale shall be mandatory for the direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a and 2b and may be visual, auditory or both.

requirements.quote: The light shall be a flashing light flashing 90 ± 30 times per minute.
requirements.text: The direction-indicator light shall flash 90 ± 30 times per minute.

requirements.quote: Operation of the light-signal control shall be followed within not more than one second by the emission of light and within not more than one and one-half seconds by its first extinction.
requirements.text: Operation of the direction-indicator control shall be followed within not more than one second by emission of light and within not more than one and a half seconds by its first extinction.

requirements.quote: The signal shall be given by simultaneous operation of the direction-indicator lamps in accordance with the requirements of paragraph 6.5. above.
requirements.text: The hazard warning signal shall be given by simultaneous operation of the direction-indicator lamps in accordance with paragraph 6.5.

requirements.quote: The signal shall be operated by means of a separate manual control enabling all the direction-indicator lamps to flash in phase.
requirements.text: The hazard warning signal shall be operated by a separate manual control enabling all direction-indicator lamps to flash in phase.

requirements.quote: The hazard warning signal shall be able to function even if the device which starts or stops the propulsion system is in a position which makes it impossible to start the propulsion system.
requirements.text: The hazard warning signal shall function even if the device that starts or stops the propulsion system is in a position making propulsion impossible.

requirements.quote: Devices of S1 or S2 categories: mandatory on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.text: Stop lamps of category S1 or S2 shall be fitted as mandatory.

requirements.quote: Devices of S3 or S4 category: mandatory on M1 and N1 categories of vehicles, except for chassis-cabs and those N1 category vehicles with open cargo space; optional on other categories of vehicles.
requirements.text: A stop lamp of category S3 or S4 shall be fitted as mandatory on the M1 vehicle, except for chassis-cabs and N1 vehicles with open cargo space.

requirements.quote: Above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm
requirements.text: Stop lamps of categories S1 or S2 shall be mounted at a height above the ground of not less than 350 mm and not more than 1,500 mm.

requirements.quote: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.text: All stop lamps shall be switched on simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.

requirements.quote: Mandatory.
requirements.text: A rear registration plate lamp shall be fitted as mandatory.

requirements.quote: Mandatory on all motor vehicles.
requirements.text: Front position lamps shall be fitted as mandatory on the motor vehicle.

requirements.quote: Two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.text: Two front position lamps shall be fitted, type approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or the 00 or subsequent series of UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.quote: In height: above the ground, not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,500 mm
requirements.text: The front position lamps shall be mounted at a height above the ground of not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,500 mm.

requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 45° inwards and 80° outwards.
requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the front position lamps shall be ensured within a horizontal angle of 45° inwards and 80° outwards.

requirements.quote: Closed-circuit tell-tale mandatory.
requirements.text: A closed-circuit tell-tale shall be mandatory for the front position lamps.

requirements.quote: Devices of R or R1 or R2 categories: Mandatory
requirements.text: Rear position lamps of category R, R1 or R2 shall be fitted as mandatory.

requirements.quote: In height: above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm
requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall be mounted at a height above the ground of not less than 350 mm and not more than 1,500 mm.

requirements.quote: Closed-circuit tell-tale mandatory. It shall be combined with that of the front position lamps.
requirements.text: A closed-circuit tell-tale shall be mandatory for the rear position lamps and shall be combined with that of the front position lamps.

requirements.quote: Devices of F or F1 or F2 categories: Mandatory.
requirements.text: A rear fog lamp of category F, F1 or F2 shall be fitted as mandatory.

requirements.quote: In height: not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,000 mm above the ground.
requirements.text: The rear fog lamp shall be mounted at a height of not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,000 mm above the ground.

requirements.quote: The rear fog-lamp(s) cannot be switched ON unless the main beams, dipped-beams or front fog-lamps are switched ON;
requirements.text: The rear fog lamp shall not be switchable on unless the main beams, dipped beams or front fog lamps are switched on.

requirements.quote: Closed-circuit tell-tale mandatory.
requirements.text: A closed-circuit tell-tale shall be mandatory for the rear fog lamp.

requirements.quote: In all cases, the distance between the rear fog-lamp and each stop-lamp shall be greater than 100 mm.
requirements.text: The distance between the rear fog lamp and each stop lamp shall be greater than 100 mm.

requirements.quote: Mandatory: On all motor vehicles the length of which exceeds 6 m.
requirements.text: Side retro-reflectors shall be mandatory on the motor vehicle where its length exceeds 6 m.

requirements.quote: Mandatory on motor vehicles. Prohibited on trailers.
requirements.text: Daytime running lamps shall be fitted as mandatory on the motor vehicle.

requirements.quote: Two, type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 87, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148
requirements.text: Two daytime running lamps shall be fitted, type approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 87, or the 00 or subsequent series of UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.quote: In height: above the ground not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,500 mm.
requirements.text: The daytime running lamps shall be mounted at a height above the ground of not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,500 mm.

requirements.quote: The daytime running lamps shall be switched ON automatically when the device which starts and/or stops the propulsion system is set in a position which makes it possible for the propulsion system to operate
requirements.text: The daytime running lamps shall be switched on automatically when the propulsion system is set in a position permitting its operation, unless the front fog lamps or headlamps are on or automatic dipped-beam conditions exist.

requirements.quote: The daytime running lamp shall switch OFF automatically when the device which starts and/or stops the propulsion system is set in a position which makes it impossible for the propulsion system to operate
requirements.text: The daytime running lamps shall switch off automatically when the propulsion system is set in a position making its operation impossible.

requirements.quote: Prohibited: on vehicles of categories M1 and O1.
requirements.text: Conspicuity markings shall be prohibited on the M1 vehicle.

requirements.quote: Mandatory on motor vehicles.
requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be mandatory on the motor vehicle.

requirements.quote: All the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz.
requirements.text: All lamps of the emergency stop signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz.

requirements.quote: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON and OFF automatically.
requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be switched on and off automatically.

requirements.quote: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON only when the vehicle speed is above 50 km/h and the braking system is providing the emergency braking logic signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be switched on only when the vehicle speed is above 50 km/h and the braking system provides the emergency braking logic signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.

requirements.quote: less than 1,000 lux ON no more than 2 seconds
requirements.text: The dipped-beam headlamps shall switch on within no more than 2 seconds when the ambient light outside the vehicle falls below 1,000 lux.

requirements.quote: more than 7,000 lux OFF more than 5 seconds, but no more than 300 seconds
requirements.text: The dipped-beam headlamps shall switch off in more than 5 seconds but no more than 300 seconds when the ambient light exceeds 7,000 lux.
